title: Require explicit succession after temporary coverage
description: Require explicit succession after temporary coverage
acceptance_criteria: After a temporary coverer is accepted, an active predecessor gets successor coverage only through an explicit valid succession obligation. On an archived predecessor, status, show and archive audit continue to warn for a file when the accepted or archived coverer lacks that obligation; a valid matching succession clears the warning and archive integrity remains independent.

answers.constraints: REQ-change-014 requires explicit closing-valid semantic succession. Archive coverage is readback evidence from REQ-change-167. It must never change archive integrity.
